correctness.rationale: For odd p, M(s,t)=e_p(ast+b(st)^{-1}) acts on multiplicative character vχ by inversion and scalar twisted Kloosterman sum Tχ. Over Q(ζ_{p−1}), p-th additive cyclotomic linear disjointness forces vanishing iff all phase-fiber weights are equal. For nontrivial χ their sum is zero, so every phase fiber must cancel. The quadratic fibers u,c/u (c=b/a) have singleton roots when c is square, forbidding zeros. For nonsquare c, pairwise cancellation requires χ(c)=−1 and χ²=1, uniquely χ=Legendre. Degenerate cases use nonzero Gauss sums and all-ones matrix. Thus rank1 at (0,0), p−2 precisely if ab≠0 nonsquare, p−1 otherwise, with explicit one-dimensional kernel. 178 numerical finite-field checks passed, not used as proof of all-prime statement.
